reasoning: The completed project collected new samples to re-test published findings. Tables 5 and 6 identify 25 distinct original papers, linked to references 45–69. Their target-specific overall classifications take precedence over NHST-only comparisons. Practical and informative failures are both coded failed. Inconclusive cells do not assert a design defect preventing adjudication, so they are not automatically coded uninformative; their outcome is retained as uncertain. The paper mentions four additional completed attempts excluded for smaller samples but does not identify them. Extra OSF project components are plans or power-analysis files and do not establish which completed attempts were excluded; no additional targets are guessed. Target and outcome quotations use verbatim table cells because the individual verdicts appear only in image tables, rather than in complete prose sentences.
